author: perrotta
body:
Add EGamma regression tags (temporarily the ones from 2025) to allow HIN EGamma regression also in the 2026 HI MC workflows, as needed after the error reported in [#52097](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51989#issuecomment-6170247996) and requested in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/request-of-new-mc-gt-for-131x-141x-and-151x/148065/12)

The new HI 2026 MC GT in autoCond is now [161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v5](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v5) and the diff wrt previous such GT in autoCond (_v4) is [here](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v4/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v5)

@Martin-Grunewald 

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

For consistency, the same update will be propagated to CMSSW_20_0_X and CMSSW_20_1_X
title: Add 2025 EG regression tags as placeholders for the 2026 HI MC GT in autoCond
